cases.sentence: Разве кушиты и ливийцы не были ___ с огромным числом колесниц и всадников?
cases.explain: «могучим войском» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Weren’t the Ethiopians and the Lubim a huge army, with chariots and exceedingly many horsemen? Yet, because you relied on Yahweh, he delivered them into your hand.

cases.sentence: Разве кушиты и ливийцы не были могучим войском с ___ колесниц и всадников?
cases.explain: «огромным числом» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Weren’t the Ethiopians and the Lubim a huge army, with chariots and exceedingly many horsemen? Yet, because you relied on Yahweh, he delivered them into your hand.

cases.sentence: Его похоронили в ___, которую он вытесал для себя в Городе Давида.
cases.explain: «могильной пещере» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: They buried him in his own tomb, which he had dug out for himself in David’s city, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odors and various kinds of spices prepared by the perfumers’ art; and they made a very great fire for him.

cases.sentence: Его положили на ложе, которое было наполнено ___, и развели в его честь огромный поминальный костер.
cases.explain: «разными благовониями» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: They buried him in his own tomb, which he had dug out for himself in David’s city, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odors and various kinds of spices prepared by the perfumers’ art; and they made a very great fire for him.
